content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS), Station HQ Chennai, Ministry of Defence, dated 11 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Ayurveda Doctor, 1 Ayurveda Pharmacist, 2 Safaiwala.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Format attached to the notice and available on www.echs.gov.in) and send it to Officer-in-Charge, ECHS Cell, Station Headquarters ECHS, Fort Saint George, Chennai - 600 009, by in a sealed envelope, in duplicate (postal mode not specified), to reach by 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Ayurveda Doctor: maximum 66 years; Ayurveda Pharmacist: maximum 56 years; Safaiwala: maximum 53 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs 95,000 for Ayurveda Doctor, Rs 36,500 for Ayurveda Pharmacist, Rs 21,800 for Safaiwala.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ayurveda Doctor: BAMS (NCISM-recognised college) with valid registration and 3 years' experience after internship; Ayurveda Pharmacist: B.Pharma or D.Pharma (Ayurveda) with valid registration and 3 years' experience; Safaiwala: Literate with 5 years' experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Preference will be given to Ex-servicemen; civilians may also apply. Valid registration required for Ayurveda Doctor and Ayurveda Pharmacist. Those who worked in an Empanelled Hospital need a clear gap of one year before joining any ECHS establishment.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates earlier employed in ECHS whose services were terminated, or who resigned/were unwilling and are blacklisted, need not apply; their applications will be rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting by the Board of Officers. Interview. Board of Officers shortlists candidates meeting eligibility criteria with completed application forms. Interview date and time informed through email/SMS; no separate call letter.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contractual engagement: 12 months for Ex-Servicemen, 11 months for others. Employment at the discretion of the appointing authority. Terms may change due to unforeseen circumstances without compensation.
